title: Higgsfield MCP paid-job ledger
description: art/ledger/higgsfield-jobs.json records every PAID Higgsfield MCP job (route higgsfield-mcp) so it survives container restarts. Written by 'pnpm gen:hf-ingest record' (from generate_image_batch / jobs_wait JSON); read by 'pnpm gen:hf-ingest' (download into art/_raw/<asset>/vNN + manifest rows), 'status' and 'check'. Unknown extra fields are allowed so the shape can grow; the fields below are checked. Prompts: a job with 'template' (+ 'vars') is re-rendered by tools/gen/lib/genlib.mjs and must hash to 'promptHash'; art/ledger/prompts/<promptHash>.txt is the stored copy used when the template no longer reproduces it (or when the job had no template).

model.description: MCP model id as REQUESTED (e.g. 'nano_banana_pro'). Jobs may report another id ('nano_banana_2' for Nano Banana Pro): see job.model.

planTier.description: Account plan when generated, e.g. 'Higgsfield Plus'.

index.description: Caller index in the generate_image_batch request.

status.description: MCP status: completed, failed, nsfw, canceled, queued, in_progress ...

model.description: Model id as REPORTED by the job (jobs_wait 'model'); goes into the manifest row.

vars.description: Render context: lower-case keys are genlib options (symbol, mascot, rigReady); UPPER_CASE keys are placeholder overrides (--var NAME=value).

asset.description: art/_raw/<asset> folder override (default: genlib defaultAsset from template + vars, else the name).

stage.description: Manifest stage override (default by template: symbols 2d-image, mascot sheets mascot-sheets, backgrounds backgrounds).

sha256.description: sha256 of the downloaded result, set by the first successful ingest; later downloads must match.
